name: Impeccable (pbakaus)
hook: 107.4k stars with the largest surge in this week's skill report (+20,928 stars this period) — the design vocabulary for coding agents. Gives your agent named design commands across three phases: steer (`bolder`, `quieter`, `typeset`, `animate`), review (`critique`, `audit`), and finish (`polish`, `harden`). Ships with a 62-rule AI slop detector that flags generic AI design patterns with no LLM or API key required, plus a live mode for in-browser element swapping.

name: Humanizer (blader)
hook: 67.5k stars (+6,851 this skill-report period). Agent skill that rewrites AI-generated text using 26 anti-pattern rules across six categories — no AI-detector bypass claims, just better writing. MIT, works in Claude Code, Codex, Claude.ai, and pi.

name: GBrain (Garry Tan)
hook: Garry Tan (Y Combinator CEO) open-sourced his personal memory layer for AI agents — 32.5k stars and appeared on GitHub trending today.
